diagnosis.summary: Run e7679933 for 2026-10-01 failed at ingest. The landing file orders.csv was cut off partway through its last row ('13666,952,2' has 3 of 7 columns and there is no trailing newline). It holds only 265 rows against 461 the day before, while order_items and payments reference orders up to 13841. I've proposed asking upstream to redeliver orders for 2026-10-01; it hasn't been applied or verified yet. If the redelivered file is still broken, escalate to upstream_app_team.

root_cause.explanation: The upstream export of orders.csv for 2026-10-01 was interrupted. The header matches the contract, but the file stops partway through row 266 with no trailing newline, so the strict CSV parse of raw.orders fails. About 175 orders (ids 13667–13841) are missing compared with the child tables. This is a one-off delivery problem, not a schema change.

evidence.claim: The ingest step failed loading raw.orders: CSV error on line 266, which has 3 columns where 7 are expected
Line 266 is the last line and the only malformed one, there is no trailing newline, the header matches the contract, and the file has 265 rows against 461 on 2026-09-30
The other tables for 10-01 parse cleanly and reference order_ids up to 13841, so the orders file is incomplete
No ingest config overrides are set
The runbook says a truncated or corrupt file should be fixed by upstream redelivery and a rerun, not by editing the file or skipping rows

alternatives_considered: Schema change (column dropped or renamed): ruled out because the header matches the contract and only the final line is short
Partial or filtered export with valid rows: ruled out because the cut-off last row shows an interrupted write
Make the parser tolerant (ignore_errors or null_padding): rejected because it would silently drop or null out data and isn't on the allow-list
rerun_only: wouldn't help because the file itself is corrupt
Redeliver all four tables: not needed because customers, order_items and payments are complete

proposal.rationale: orders.csv for 2026-10-01 was cut off partway through a row. The last line '13666,952,2' has 3 of 7 fields and there is no trailing newline. The file has 265 rows against 461 the day before, and child tables reference orders up to 13841. The header matches the contract and no other table is affected. Per the runbook this is a one-off corrupt or truncated delivery, so we ask for a redelivery of orders for that day and rerun. We do not hand-edit the file or skip rows.
